# NG+ Game Trailers

> Vancouver-based trailer studio making game trailers for solo developers and indie teams: Steam page trailers, reveal and launch trailers, festival cuts and publisher pitch videos.

NG+ Game Trailers (also written NG+ Trailers) is a boutique trailer studio in Vancouver, Canada, working with indie teams worldwide. It turns hundreds of hours of gameplay into short trailers built to drive Steam wishlists and sales.

## Services

- Steam page trailers: optimized for the scroll-and-watch behavior of Steam users.
- Reveal and launch trailers: high-impact pieces designed to get attention and drive wishlists and sales.
- Festival cuts: snappy edits for Steam showcase events and seasonal fests.
- Publisher pitch videos: videos that prove a game's mechanics, loop and market viability.
- Trailer strategy: analysis of a game's hooks and the best way to frame them.

## Work

- Before Your Eyes: launch trailer
- Manifold Garden: Switch trailer
- Fields of Mistria: Wholesome Direct trailer
- Pacific Drive: update trailer
